scope: Material subpart distinctions for three existing Grade 7 parent expectations; no new identifiers or placement claims

material_conditions: Approximate probabilities by collecting data on the chance process and observing its long-run relative frequency
Given a probability, predict an approximate relative frequency in repeated trials
Observed results in finite trials need not equal exact expected counts
7.SP.7.a: assign equal probabilities to all outcomes in a uniform model
7.SP.7.b: model probabilities from observed frequencies of a chance process; this empirical model may be nonuniform
Compare predicted model probabilities and observed frequencies; explain possible discrepancies
7.SP.8.a: probabilities of compound events are fractions of outcomes in sample space
7.SP.8.b: map everyday-language events to outcomes by organized lists, tables and tree diagrams
7.SP.8.c: design and use simulations that generate event frequencies to approximate compound-event probabilities
